title: Miso-Glazed Salmon Uramaki
description: Fully cooked salmon with white miso, mirin and honey, softened by avocado.

ingredients.name: Prepared, seasoned sushi rice
ingredients.note: Use the separate Sushi Rice recipe

steps: Mix white miso, mirin and honey. Simmer gently for a minute or two to combine and reduce the mirin.
Pat salmon dry and cook through over medium heat. Brush with the glaze near the end, turning gently; avoid charring the miso. Cut into strips.
Cover a bamboo mat in food-safe wrap. Spread rice on a half-sheet of nori, sprinkle sesame on the rice, flip it rice-side-down, then arrange cooked salmon and avocado across the nori.
Roll firmly, shape evenly and cut into eight pieces with a clean, damp knife.
notes: Miso is naturally salty; taste the glaze before adding any soy sauce.
This baseline yields approximately four rolls (or the equivalent nigiri, gunkan or hand-roll assortment), about six light servings.
Sushi rice is prepared and seasoned separately; the rice quantity here is its ready-to-use weight.
Salmon is fully cooked, including the very thin seared-slice variations; for thicker pieces, 63°C at the center is a conservative target.
